milestones.title: Team iConnect is born
milestones.text: A group of students at GJUS&T comes together under the Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay Innovation & Incubation Centre with one goal — bridge the gap between students and the tech-driven world.

milestones.title: Smart India Hackathon
milestones.text: iConnect organizes the internal hackathon for SIH 2024 at GJUS&T, screening and mentoring teams for the national-level competition.

milestones.title: Konark — The Chariot of Innovation
milestones.text: The flagship techfest of GJUS&T brings workshops, hackathons and competitions to campus, becoming the university's #1 tech festival.

milestones.title: E-Summit
milestones.text: A full entrepreneurship summit with keynote speakers, startup founders, pitch competitions and panel discussions.

milestones.title: Seed Funding Opportunity
milestones.text: PDUIIC opens seed grants of up to ₹1.5 lakh for student innovators — funding, mentorship and workspace to turn ideas into ventures.

milestones.title: 56+ events and counting
milestones.text: 25,000+ footfalls across events, 1M+ impressions across platforms — and a new team carrying the mission forward every year.
